To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CDM ESD performance is strongly affected by layout styles of the MOS devices in the 65-nm nanoscale CMOs process.

the layout styles to improve CSD ESD robustness are the following: (i) the MOSFETs with longer channel length, (ii) the MOSFETS with smaller gate area, and (iii) the MOSFECTS with larger source and drain areas.
the layout styles to improve CCM ESD robustness in 65-nM CMOS technology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the layout optimization to improve CDM robustness in a 65 nm CMOS process.
the CDM ESD protection design for nanoscale ICs, and the results can be applied to the design and optimization of CDM ESD protections for the SoC products in 65-nM CMOS process.
the layout styles of the MOS devices in a 65 nm CMOS process to improve the CDM ESD reliability of integrated circuits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a single finger layout style is the most suitable layout style for a MOS device in the 65-nm process to achieve the best CDM ESD protection performance.
the layout styles of MOS transistors can be optimized to improve the CDM ESD protection performance of integrated circuits in the nanoscaled CMOS technology.
the layout styles of MOS transistors should be designed to minimize the parasitic bipolar transistor and to maximize the parasitic diode for the best CDM ESD protection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the layout style should not only be optimized for good ESD robustness but also be considered for the circuit performance and chip area.

the MOS devices with layout styles of the source/drain regions in a single line and the gate region in a single line have the worst CDM ESD performance, and the MOS devices with the layout styles of the gate region and the source/drain region in a single row can achieve the best CDM ESD protection.
the MOS device with the gate length of 1.5 μm, the gate width of 1.0 μm, the spacing of 0.3 μm, and the gate-to-drain overlap of 0.1 μm can achieve the highest CDM ESD protection capability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CDM ESD protection design should avoid the use of the long gate length of MOS devices in the layout.
, for the same device width, the MOS device layout with a smaller layout area has a better CDM ESD performance.
the layout styles of the MOS devices should be carefully considered during the design stage to improve the CDM ESD protection performance of the IC products.
